cause: Training/serving skew on f3 caused by a missing/inconsistent log transform. Both CSVs were ingested into Hopsworks feature groups (training_skew, serving_skew) and compared via platform-computed feature statistics. f1, f2, f4 and f5 match in range/mean/stddev across the two paths, but f3 diverges sharply: training f3 lies in [0.57, 5.01] with mean 2.20 and stddev 0.76, while serving f3 spans [0.76, 148.27] with mean 11.74 and stddev 14.55. The percentiles satisfy serving_f3 ~= exp(training_f3) (e.g. training p50=2.12 -> exp~8.3 vs serving p50~7.5; p75=2.67 -> exp~14.4 vs serving p75~13.2), i.e. the training pipeline applied a natural-log transform to f3 that the online serving path omitted (it served the raw, untransformed value).
